title: Error-Generator-Level Compression for Fast Quantum Gates
summary: Fast quantum gates in multilevel systems require suppressing many coherent-error channels using pulses that remain simple to implement. We introduce error-generator-level compression, a Magnus-based control principle that minimizes the complete projected error generator at a chosen perturbative order while restricting the implemented waveform to a few independently adjustable coefficients.
